description.value: Fat Bastard Burrito is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain serving fully customizable burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made to order with fresh-daily proteins and housemade salsas. This Langley location sits in the 88 Avenue commercial corridor and offers takeout with no drive-through. A touring cyclist looking for a quick, filling, customizable meal would find a broad range of protein and topping options.
